iot_spike.summary: Synthetic IoT operations: 3 sites, 8 devices, 15 alerts and 1,440 telemetry readings in the seeded fixture. Ask about connectivity, monthly subscription fees, alert severity, downtime, temperature, uptime and throughput. Time-series data covers July to mid-August 2026 (Asia/Taipei).
iot_spike.limitations: Lease ownership is not defined. Median is not a supported aggregate. Suggested questions are examples, not a guarantee of correct interpretation.
questions: How many alerts were raised at each severity level in July 2026?
What was the average temperature at each site in July 2026?

service_test.summary: Synthetic service operations: 3 teams, 4 projects, 8 tickets, 10 work logs, 9 ticket events and 2 team links in the seeded fixture. Ask about ticket counts, logged minutes, estimates, teams, projects and records without activity. Dated work logs cover January to March 2026; some work dates or minutes are NULL.
service_test.limitations: Work-log rows and distinct tickets are different counts. No contractual SLA definition is supplied. Average time from ticket creation to closure is outside the current query algebra.
questions: How many work-log records are there, and how many have a minutes value? Count zero minutes as a value.
What is the total logged time in minutes for each team?
Show total logged minutes by month from January through March 2026, using the work-log date.
